title: Idle Fantasy(Working Title) my new Multiplayer Idle MMO
author: Alltimegamers
selftext:
I've been working on Idle Fantasy for around 30 days now. It's my attempt an a more "MMO focused idler". I love MMO's but don't have thousands of hours to sit around and sink time into them. 

The multiplayer is still in it's infancy but it works. There is currently dungeons, parties, friends, and a guild system. I focused on a player driven economy handled by the various guilds. I want to build an idle game that feels like an MMO but without all the fluff and being able to level/grind while offline.

Dungeons are fully playable offline/idling with friends. You can join a party, start a dungeon, then your characters will just keep running the dungeon together until someone eventually runs out of food and dies OR the idle caps out at 48HR.

My workflow for the project was mostly Opus 5.5 in Claude Code using a ComfyUI connection to generate 99% of the assets. I let Claude do all the asset generation and review on it's own. But it had strict guidelines. Every asset required 3 version be created, then review all 3 for "AI Sloppiness" and matching to the original prompt. I'm fairly happy with how the results came out.

As it evolves I plan to focus more and more on the player driven side of it as well as more quests/tasks/and timed events. Currently there is one timed event in the game.

I have it as an unlisted Beta on Steam currently and have a handful of people testing it. I do still have some Beta keys available. If anyone is interested in testing it please send me a DM. Really looking for feedback on gameplay and if it's actually "fun". I really enjoy playing it, but it's hard to tell if it's actually fun for anyone other than me.
